title: Update Rule
description: Update specific details of a rule.

body.name: name
body.description: Pass the name of the rule within 50 characters.

body.name: description
body.description: Pass the description of the rule within 2000 characters.

body.name: is_active
body.description: Pass true to activate the rule. Else pass false.

body.name: status
body.description: Pass the status of the rule.

body.name: tags
body.description: Pass the list of tag IDs added to the rule.

body.name: trigger_on_update
body.description: Pass true to trigger the rule after an update. Else pass false.

body.name: retry_on_broken
body.description: Pass true to retry running the rule after a failed attempt. Else pass false.

body.name: run_rule_after_enrich
body.description: Pass true to run the rule after every enrichment. Else pass false.

body.name: exclude_wl
body.description: Pass true to exclude the allowed threat data from passing in the rule. Else pass false.

body.name: exclude_fp
body.description: Pass true to exclude the false-positive threat data from passing in the rule. Else pass false.

body.name: is_follow
body.description: Pass true to follow the rule. Else pass false.

body.name: is_manual_run
body.description: Pass true to enable manually running the rule. Else pass false.

body.name: priority
body.description: Indicates the importance or execution order of the rule.

body.name: retry_on_broken
body.description: Boolean flag that determines whether the rule should be retried if it fails during execution.

body.name: run_rule_after_enrich
body.description: Returns true if the rule is configured to run after the enrichment policy, else returns false.

body.name: exclude_wl
body.description: Returns true to exclude allowed threat data from passing in the rules, else returns false.

body.name: exclude_fp
body.description: Returns true to exclude false-positive threat data from passing in the rules, else returns false.

body.name: is_follow
body.description: Returns true if the current user follows the rule, else returns false.

body.name: ctix_created
body.description: Returns the time and date in epoch format when the rule was created.

body.name: ctix_modified
body.description: Returns the time and date in epoch format when the rule was last modified.

body.name: is_manual_run
body.description: Boolean flag that specifies whether the rule was triggered manually by a user, rather than automatically by the system based on predefined conditions.

body.name: all_sources_and_collections
body.description: Returns true if all sources are configured on the rule, else returns false.
